out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: cooked beef, cooked chicken in WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. PIC understands all cooked prepared foods kept for more than 24 hours must be date marked. PIC has date marked the aforementioned food items accordingly.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: Observed pork oil that was not marked to indicate the end point.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. PIC was informed to keep and update log records on daily basis to maintain Time as Public Health Control. PIC provided end points.

violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter throughout kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PIC placed wet wiping cloths in sanitizer solution.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Observed utensils in-use stored in a water container at the service area with the water temperature at 68F.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC removed utensils from the water container and properly cleaned and sanitized them.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not designed or constructed to be easily cleanable: Observed dry storage rack shelves in the kitchen constructed of untreated wood which is not a smooth, non absorbent, and easily cleanable surface.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces shall be free of unnecessary ledges, projections, and crevices, and designed and constructed to allow easy cleaning and to facilitate maintenance. EHS discussed with PIC that the shelves must be maintained as smooth, non absorbent, and easily cleanable surfaces. Please remove the untreated wood shelves or property paint them with an approved coating. YU NOODLES CAFE (Inspection Date: 08/19/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Observed raw beef stored above cooked chicken dumplings in 2 DR prep cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS instructed PIC on the proper storage of raw animal foods and ready-to-eat foods to prevent cross- contamination. PIC placed raw beef below ready-to-eat foods.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, Clean after Use
violations.observation: Equipment food-contact surfaces/utensils were not observed cleaned before any possible contamination. Observed inadequate sanitizing of dish-ware in dish machine. The final rinse sanitizer concentration is less than 10ppm.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be cleaned at any time during the operation when contamination may have occurred. PIC set up sanitizer with adequate concentration of chlorine bleach in the 3 compartment sink and sanitized dish-ware properly.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitizing, Contact Time Met
violations.observation: The dish machine observed unable to provide adequate concentration of chlorine bleach. Observed chemical chlorine bleach concentration at<10ppm.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dischmachine so that food contact surfaces are exposed to sanitizer for the required amount of time per the data plate. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food contact surfaces. PIC discontinued use of dish machine until repair is completed. PIC set up sanitizer with adequate concentration of chlorine bleach in the 3 compartment sink to adequately sanitize all food contact equipment.
